events.doc: A production: every named document's range in argument order (assigned is false for a document the matter produced before), the Produce record that numbered the new ones (null when nothing new was numbered: then nothing was written), and the files written into the new volume directory.
events.name: production_recorded

shapes.doc: A scheduled reversal an open would mint: its ReversalSchedule, the Adjusting entry it reverses, and the reverse_on date.
shapes.name: scheduled_reversal

shapes.doc: One foreign Asset/Liability source and its exclusively assigned same-type functional-currency valuation leaf and Revenue/Expense unrealized destination.
shapes.name: fx_revaluation_route

shapes.doc: Summary of a recorded REA `Event` vertex.
shapes.name: event_summary

shapes.doc: Complete record of an REA `Event` vertex.
shapes.name: event_detail

shapes.doc: One economic resource delta on an REA `Event`.
shapes.name: event_resource

shapes.doc: An external system identifier pair `(system, id)`.
shapes.name: external_id

shapes.doc: One payment leg's open-item application summary in a reviewed settlement artifact.
shapes.name: settlement_application

shapes.doc: One journaled custody event (`receipt` or `transfer`) on a document.
shapes.name: custody_event

shapes.doc: One staged migration chunk entry and its proposal digest.
shapes.name: migration_chunk

shapes.doc: One exact retained migration proposal: its native entry identity, approval digest, effective date, original source document date, mapped legs and optional staged sequence. PeriodBalances and FullDetail include effective_period for the native destination. FullDetail counts_after_finalize identifies chunks eligible to affect balances and open items once the run is finalized: all sole-source detail, or separate opening stock and detail dated on or after the non-sole opening boundary. Earlier non-sole detail remains available for drilldown; an Abandoned run always reports false because it can never activate. This flag does not assert that an Open run is already visible. A null or absent recorded_at means this package chunk has not been staged.
shapes.name: legacy_migration_chunk

shapes.doc: One mapped leg of a retained migration proposal; amount is positive in its native unit and side gives debit or credit.
shapes.name: legacy_migration_leg

shapes.doc: One account/unit difference between a migration run's declared trial balance and the folded staged chunks.
shapes.name: migration_mismatch

shapes.doc: One check of `fa doctor` (or of `fa triage`'s derived state): its name, its status (ok, warn, fail, skipped), what it found, and the exact fix when it is not ok.
shapes.name: doctor_check

shapes.doc: One state's recomputation result. evidence_after_seq is the state's evidence boundary (null: entries alone); it must be the boundary the state's place on the chain implies. leaf_kinds is the recomputed prefix's leaves by record kind, null when the state was refused before its prefix was read. finding is null on success; verification failure reports the same shape in its detail.
shapes.name: accumulator_state_check

shapes.doc: An accumulator prefix's leaves by record kind (fa-va02); the counts sum to its leaf_count.
shapes.name: accumulator_leaf_kinds

shapes.doc: One selected population item: its id (entry vid hex and five-digit leg ordinal), entry and ordinal, open amount as book value, for MUS its selection basis and the cumulative dollar hit (null for top-stratum items and uniform samples), and for a stratified sample its declared stratum.
shapes.name: sample_item

shapes.doc: One declared stratum of a stratified sample: its name (b01 upward, in band order), the bound it lies above (null for b01) and at most (null for the last), its population count, the standard deviation of its book values (integer square root of the exact population variance; null when empty), and the sample size allocated to it.
shapes.name: sample_stratum

shapes.doc: One overstated sample item: book and audited values, the overstatement, whether it is in the top stratum, and for the other items the exact tainting (overstatement over book value, as numerator/denominator) and its rank among the taintings (1 is the largest).
shapes.name: sample_misstatement

shapes.doc: One engagement: its id and vertex, kind, firm principal, scope periods, the stated materiality parameters in its unit, the report release day, state, who opened it and when, its next proposal number, and how many proposals are proposed, booked and passed.
shapes.name: engagement_summary

shapes.doc: What booking a correction would change, in one unit: net income (positive raises it), assets (debits less credits), liabilities and equity (credits less debits).
shapes.name: statement_effect

shapes.doc: One prior engagement's uncorrected proposal carried into the summary (SAB 108): its number in the prior engagement and its date; what became of it as the latest carry-forward states (Uncorrected, TurnedAround or Corrected); what correcting it would change now in the engagement's unit (an uncorrected item at this period's end, its prior income in opening retained earnings; a turned-around one in this period's income against opening retained earnings; a corrected one nothing); whether every line is within the stated clearly trivial threshold; and the other units its legs carry.
shapes.name: sud_carried

shapes.doc: One Lantern finding in an engagement's index: the finding's vid, its File record, sequence and principal, and whether it was filed after the documentation completion (AS 1215.16).
shapes.name: engagement_finding

shapes.doc: One journaled carry-forward of an engagement: the prior engagement, the prior proposals stated turned around and corrected, its record, sequence and principal, and whether it was recorded after the documentation completion.
shapes.name: engagement_carry_forward

shapes.doc: One out-of-period correction in the summary of uncorrected misstatements (plan §8.2, SAB 108): the standing Adjusting entry that corrected an earlier period's error in this period, its date, the period the error belongs to, what moving it out of this period's income would change (its income effect reversed, against opening retained earnings in equity), whether every line is within the stated clearly trivial threshold, and the other units its legs carry (listed, never converted).
shapes.name: sud_out_of_period

shapes.doc: One uncorrected proposal in the summary of uncorrected misstatements: its number and date; why it is uncorrected, either the registered reason it was passed or, for a booking whose entry was since reversed or replaced, the booked entry and the entry that superseded it; its statement effect in the engagement's unit; whether every line is within the stated clearly trivial threshold; and the other units its legs carry (listed, never converted).
shapes.name: sud_item

shapes.doc: The summary of uncorrected misstatements over one statement definition's lines (plan §11.12, per statement line): the definition and its title, and every line in order with the amount it would change by had every uncorrected proposal been booked, in the engagement's unit.
shapes.name: sud_statement

shapes.doc: One statement line's share of the uncorrected misstatements, under the line's own sign (a debit line rises with debits, a credit line with credits); a formula line adds and subtracts the lines it names.
shapes.name: sud_line

shapes.doc: One leg of a proposed correcting entry: side, the account's code and vertex, and the amount.
shapes.name: proposal_leg

shapes.doc: How a proposal was decided: book (the committed entry that made the correction) or pass (the registered reason it was left uncorrected), with the record, its sequence and who decided. superseded_by names the entry that has since reversed or replaced a booked entry: the decision stays on the record, and the proposal is uncorrected again.
shapes.name: proposal_decision

shapes.doc: One proposed adjustment: its engagement and number, vertex, the effective date and legs of the draft correcting entry (which never posts), the Propose record, its sequence and principal, its state (proposed, booked or passed), and its decision.
shapes.name: proposal_row

shapes.doc: One document in an engagement's workpaper index: its oid, the File record, its sequence and principal, whether it was filed after the documentation completion (AS 1215.16), and the Confirmed or Represented attestation over it, if any.
shapes.name: engagement_workpaper

shapes.doc: A confirmation in the workpaper index (AS 2310): the Confirmed attestation, the confirming party, the balance and date it confirmed, who attested it, who received the confirmation document (its custody receipt), and whether it is audit-grade for this engagement: true only when the engagement's firm principal received it.
shapes.name: workpaper_confirmation

shapes.doc: A management representation letter in the workpaper index (AS 2805): the Represented attestation, how many claims it represents (each sealed under the book key), as of when, and who attested it.
shapes.name: workpaper_representation

shapes.doc: An engagement's journaled documentation completion (AS 1215.15): the report release date, the completion date at most 45 days after it, and its Complete record, sequence and principal.
shapes.name: documentation_completion

shapes.doc: An open item on the account's other side, outside the positive-value population, to be tested separately.
shapes.name: sample_excluded

shapes.doc: One procedures.toml row.
shapes.name: procedure_row

shapes.doc: `fa capabilities`: one registered Lantern procedure and the claim class of its output (doctrine 12: a score or threshold test is `statistical`, never an invariant); `fa procedure list` has the full row.
shapes.name: procedure_claim

shapes.doc: A declared input: its name, kind (date, period, account, entry) and meaning.
shapes.name: procedure_input_decl

shapes.doc: A registered parameter with its pinned default (the decision card's deterministic fallback).
shapes.name: procedure_parameter_decl

shapes.doc: A parameter value the run used.
shapes.name: procedure_parameter

shapes.doc: An input the run used, as its canonical string (handles are 32-hex vids).
shapes.name: procedure_input

shapes.doc: Work counted while the procedure ran: the complexity witness against the registry's declared bound.
shapes.name: lantern_work

shapes.doc: One finding: its severity band, the statistic it rests on, its typed citations (every one resolves in the book) and a narrative built only from resolved handles and numbers.
shapes.name: finding

shapes.doc: The test statistic in fixed point (`value` at `scale` decimal places) with the size of the population it was computed over.
shapes.name: statistic

shapes.doc: A typed citation: `kind` is entry, leg, account, period, document, principal, approval or attestation, and exactly the fields that kind carries are non-null. Attestation references name their native Attestation vertex; they are never presented as Entry references.
shapes.name: cite

shapes.doc: One citation: the document, its commitment, and the EVIDENCED_BY role (evidence_policy.toml [[role]]).
shapes.name: evidence_ref

shapes.doc: A spelling that expands in the verb position.
shapes.name: alias

shapes.doc: One row of the exit-code dictionary.
shapes.name: exit_code

shapes.doc: How to switch on robot mode and where the schema lives.
shapes.name: robot_mode

shapes.doc: The capability model this build enforces (plan §14.2, §14.4): the closed op vocabulary, the base profiles and the ops each can never hold, the caveats' semantics, the embedded posture's binding, and the digest of the policy (sod_policy.toml) a PolicyActivation must name.
shapes.name: capability_model

shapes.doc: A base profile and the ops a capability under it can never hold.
shapes.name: capability_profile

shapes.doc: The actual execution binding: embedded-owner self-issues Human operations per command; MCP uses one trusted launch capability and exposes no per-call identity or authority flags. Neither posture authenticates the operator.
shapes.name: capability_binding

shapes.doc: Execution authority: mcp-launch-config names the fixed principal, launch template (agent or preparer), and exact bounded ops. issued-token names a session bound to a holder's issued token (fa-mcp --token; fa --token): the token's principal, the profile it was issued under (an issued Human capability reports preparer) and its exact journaled ops; the kernel admits it only against its journaled issuance. Embedded-owner has Human profile and null ops because it self-issues per command; principal is null until parsed. Launch configuration does not authenticate the operator.
shapes.name: authority

shapes.doc: The robot-mode envelope: its version, the fields every line carries beside its event's own, and the wire frames that carry none.
shapes.name: envelope_doc

shapes.doc: One event's schema and the verbs that emit it (empty for the global events). `book` is true when the event is always about one book (its envelope `coordinate` is never null); `fields` are the event's own, beside the envelope's.
shapes.name: event_doc

shapes.doc: One nested object's schema.
shapes.name: shape_doc

shapes.doc: One field and its type.
shapes.name: field_doc

shapes.doc: An account row (as in shape account) with its normal side (debit or credit), parent code (null at a root), children codes, opened/closed/promoted_on dates (null when not journaled) and the commit that created it.
shapes.name: chart_account_detail

shapes.doc: One chart row; the bounds and `limit_scope` (lifetime: the account's whole history; period: a budget cap per fiscal period) are null unless the chart declared a balance limit.
shapes.name: account

shapes.doc: One period with its current state.
shapes.name: period

shapes.doc: One held document's public metadata: its oid, registered kind, media type, provenance grade, byte size, commitment and recorded sequence.
shapes.name: document_summary

shapes.doc: One party: its code, kind, vertex id, opened name (untrusted text, null when erased) and recorded sequence.
shapes.name: party_summary

shapes.doc: One legal entity: its code, name, jurisdiction, functional unit, formed and dissolved dates, the count of external ids it was created with, its vertex id and recorded sequence.
shapes.name: legal_entity_summary

shapes.doc: One instrument: its code, name, kind, unit, vertex id, the party it is held at, the account it mirrors, and its recorded sequence.
shapes.name: instrument_summary

shapes.doc: One output file of an export: its name in the package, its length, its digest (fa:export-file:v1), and its content when returned inline.
shapes.name: export_file

shapes.doc: One entry of a committed PostBatch, in member order.
shapes.name: batch_member

shapes.doc: A draft as its DraftControl records state it (plan §15.2).
shapes.name: draft_summary

shapes.doc: One planned intent: its Plan record and the entry its promotion will create.
shapes.name: draft_intent

shapes.doc: One scenario as its records state it: owner, state, the trunk sequence it replays, the date its counterfactual starts, its assumption documents and intent count.
shapes.name: scenario_summary

shapes.doc: One account and unit a scenario changes: trunk and scenario debits and credits, posted and pending (reserved, unposted) apart, and the signed change in each net (debits - credits) balance.
shapes.name: scenario_diff_row

shapes.doc: A hypothetical member's exact entry identity and immutable entry digest. It is a scratch result, and becomes trunk membership only through separately authorized promotion.
shapes.name: draft_entry_ref

shapes.doc: One changed account and native unit: original and rehearsed stock balances, with posted and pending debits and credits kept apart. Each delta is the checked change in debit-minus-credit net.
shapes.name: draft_diff_row

shapes.doc: A capability as its journaled issuance records it (plan §14.2). daily_totals bounds cumulative gross debits per native unit and committed UTC day. daily_root is the original quota issuance commitment for a descendant; null means this issuance starts its own root when daily_totals is nonempty, or has no daily quota when the array is empty. The scope caveats (null when absent) confine what the holder reaches and are judged before any query, never as a result filter: books by id, accounts by subtree root code, periods by code, effective dates through effective_through, recorded frontiers through known_at_most, one branch, and redaction by registered contract.
shapes.name: issued_capability

shapes.doc: A per-leg ceiling: the maximum mantissa at the unit's scale.
shapes.name: capability_ceiling

shapes.doc: A cumulative daily gross-debit limit in one native unit, expressed as a positive maximum mantissa at that unit's scale. Descendants share the original issuance's usage and may only narrow their limits.
shapes.name: capability_daily_total

shapes.doc: One account in one unit.
shapes.name: tb_row

shapes.doc: One account and optional legal entity in the book's functional currency, in a posted or pending stock/activity column. net is exact debits less credits.
shapes.name: functional_tb_row

shapes.doc: Checked exact debit, credit and net totals in the functional currency for one stock or activity column.
shapes.name: functional_tb_totals

shapes.doc: How a head trial balance or period activity was answered (plan §5.3, §17). mode maintained: every contributing period from its maintained register cells at their cursor plus the exact tail after it; tail_length counts the entries decoded for those tails. mode literal: the journal was folded, and reason says why maintained cells could not answer and how to make them answer. Both modes yield the same report. Null for certified, historical, as-of and summary reads, which always fold the journal.

shapes.doc: One period maintained cells answered: its maintenance cursor and the entries decoded for its tail.
shapes.name: tb_served_period

shapes.doc: A current or comparative period selection. Stock includes opening history through the inclusive cutoff; activity starts at effective_from. Every column uses the statement's same known-at snapshot.
shapes.name: statement_column

shapes.doc: One mapped or computed line in one native unit; amounts appear in the order of the statement columns. There is no summation across units.
shapes.name: statement_line

shapes.doc: A historical leaf account and its unique registered mapped line; computed lines refer to mapped lines rather than mapping an account a second time.
shapes.name: statement_mapping

shapes.doc: One root account and its disjoint leaf partition in a summary trial balance.
shapes.name: summary_group

shapes.doc: One statement line's before, after, and exact `after - before` delta amounts across the statement columns.
shapes.name: statement_line_change

shapes.doc: A leaf account whose statement mapping changed between `before_known_at` and `after_known_at`.
shapes.name: statement_mapping_change

shapes.doc: One adjacent recorded sequence step in a statement trace, with its entry links and sparse line/mapping changes.

shapes.doc: Metadata-only entry link for a statement trace publication step (`recorded` or `became_visible`).
shapes.name: statement_entry_link

shapes.doc: One selected account/unit cell in a general-ledger detail report.

shapes.doc: One ordered posted leg movement with running balance in a general-ledger detail report.

shapes.doc: One activity classification bucket in a roll-forward lead schedule.
shapes.name: roll_forward_bucket

shapes.doc: One account/unit row in a roll-forward lead schedule: `opening` plus `activity` aligned with `buckets` equals `closing`.
shapes.name: roll_forward_row

shapes.doc: One unit's statement of changes in equity, credit-normal (credits minus debits): opening contributed equity (equity accounts) and unclosed earnings (revenue and expense not yet closed), their total, net income, issuances, distributions, other equity movements, the closing transfer's net (zero), the net change and the closing stocks; tie_out_residual = opening total + net change - closing total, which is zero.
shapes.name: equity_roll_forward_unit

shapes.doc: One classified equity leg of a statement of changes in equity: its entry digest and leg index, recorded sequence, effective date, entry class, kind (issuance or distribution from the named accounts, other_equity for any other equity leg, closing_transfer for every leg of a Closing entry), account, side and amount.
shapes.name: equity_movement

shapes.doc: One effective-date age band in days (`upper_inclusive` is null for the open-ended final band).
shapes.name: aging_band

shapes.doc: One open item with its effective-date age in civil days and assigned band index.
shapes.name: aged_open_item

shapes.doc: Nonnegative debit and credit open-item sums for one account, native unit, and age band.
shapes.name: aging_cell

shapes.doc: Nonnegative debit and credit open-item totals across all age bands for one account and native unit.

shapes.doc: One native-unit row tying an account's posted trial-balance net to its open-item net (`difference` = `posted_net - open_net`).

shapes.doc: One selected posting leaf in an aging portfolio: its native-unit control rows, whether every row has zero difference, and its open-item count.

shapes.doc: Gross inflows, gross outflows, and net movement for one cash-flow activity section in one native unit.

shapes.doc: One selected original cash leg's derived activity and its basis: `account_rules` (every nonzero non-cash counterpart in its entry and unit has that activity), `override` (an explicit whole-leg choice), or `internal_transfer` (exact cancellation across distinct cash accounts within one entry and unit).
shapes.name: cash_flow_decision

shapes.doc: Direct cash-flow summary for one native unit: `opening` plus `net_change` across operating, investing, financing, and exchange effects equals `closing`.
shapes.name: cash_flow_unit

shapes.doc: A cited original cash leg and the professional reason for splitting its exact native amount into positive activity portions. The entry digest and leg index identify the source at the fixed report coordinate.
shapes.name: cash_flow_leg_split

shapes.doc: One explicit cash-flow activity portion, rendered as an exact positive amount in its original cash leg's native unit. The leg's bank direction is inherited; portions cannot introduce a currency conversion or a balancing residual.
shapes.name: cash_flow_portion

shapes.doc: Indirect cash-flow reconciliation for one native unit: `net_income` plus `non_cash`, `working_capital`, and `non_operating` equals `operating` (`direct_operating` with zero `operating_residual`).
shapes.name: indirect_cash_flow_unit

shapes.doc: One non-cash leg adjustment's signed contribution to the indirect operating-cash reconciliation.
shapes.name: indirect_cash_flow_contribution

shapes.doc: Posted totals of one unit.
shapes.name: unit_total

shapes.doc: Pending totals of one unit.
shapes.name: pending_unit_total

shapes.doc: One embedded chart template.
shapes.name: chart_template

shapes.doc: One live posted leg and what has been applied to and from it.
shapes.name: open_item

shapes.doc: One application against an open item.
shapes.name: application

shapes.doc: One materialized period's register cache in fa triage: its cache_status (verified, corrupt or uninitialized), the verified_through watermark of the journal prefix it folded, and lag_entries, the journal entries recorded after it (fa registers advance folds them in).
shapes.name: register_lag

shapes.doc: One period's verify-by-refold at its processed basis (not its last monetary contribution). cache_status is uninitialized, verified, or corrupt. verified_through is null on a mismatch or an uninitialized cache; empty uninitialized caches compare green but certify no prefix. When green, stale reports unread journal entries and lag_entries counts their book-wide Entry creations, including controls and staged migrations; projection-only commits do not count.
shapes.name: register_check

shapes.doc: One period's per-entity refold: known_at is the frontier it was proved at, cells_checked the (account, unit, entity) cells, entries_checked the period's committed entries, fold_digest the refold's digest, findings each drift found (empty when green).
shapes.name: entity_check

shapes.doc: One ranked search hit: kind (entry), id (the entry's vid as 32-hex, for fa entry show), recorded_at (its creating sequence), score_micro (BM25 in micro-units), the query terms it matched, and a snippet of its text.
shapes.name: search_hit

shapes.doc: A stored register cell that differs from the refold (raw mantissas).
shapes.name: cell_drift

shapes.doc: A register column's raw mantissas and entry count.
shapes.name: cell_values

shapes.doc: A leg whose applied mirror differs from the open-item fold.
shapes.name: applied_drift

shapes.doc: One limited account's cell: its bounds, net, and pending flows in its normal-balance sign, and the refolded cell's generation. `period` names the fiscal period of a budget cap's cell (one row per period); null for a lifetime limit.
shapes.name: account_availability

shapes.doc: A limited account whose expected LimitCell differs from the refold (raw mantissas), or is bound (account_ref) to another account or to none, or (a budget cap's cell) to another period: `stored_account` is the vid the stored cell claims (null when the cell or its reference is missing or malformed), `stored_account_code` its code when it is an account of this book; `period` is the cell's fiscal period and `stored_period` the period it claims (null for a lifetime cell).
shapes.name: availability_drift

shapes.doc: A LimitCell's raw mantissas and its generation.
shapes.name: limit_cell

shapes.doc: One fiscal period's stored state mirror compared with its refolded state from birth through its journaled PeriodControl transitions.
shapes.name: period_check

shapes.doc: One recorded forensic run whose original certificate and observations fully replayed for this page. The publication identity and producer remain distinct from its source coordinate. certificate selects its complete finding set; no current human review status is inferred.
shapes.name: recorded_finding_run

shapes.doc: One immutable certified observation with its stable native identity, original coordinate and producer, plus its verified human review history at the requested cutoff. The nested finding never changes when its review status changes.
shapes.name: recorded_finding

shapes.doc: One append-only Human decision bound to its finding, explicit predecessor, current capability and retained evidence. reason is present only for dismissal; note is the reviewer's explanation.
shapes.name: finding_review

shapes.doc: A selected native journal entry bound by both its vertex identity and canonical entry digest. A bank match additionally names its exact cash-leg ordinal.
shapes.name: bank_entry_ref

shapes.doc: One retained bank line with status proposed, unmatched, confirmed or occupied. Confirmed rows preserve the original DecisionCard, proposal digest, proposer, cash-leg coordinates and confirmed_match reference. Occupied means another retained interpretation already claims this original source line. Available eligibility excludes only native active claims and is computed before greedy proposal consumption; deterministic tie-breaking does not resolve ambiguity. Imported counterparty and reference text remain explicitly untrusted.
shapes.name: bank_match_proposal

shapes.doc: An immutable exact-match confirmation with original native publication identity, retained source lineage and actual cash-leg ordinal. Proposer is preserved from proposal bytes; confirmed_by and capability_commitment identify the admitted confirmer. These recorded facts survive later reversals and establish neither a live matched balance nor reconciled-through date.
shapes.name: bank_confirmation

shapes.doc: An exact immutable bank decision identified by its native VID and canonical payload digest.
shapes.name: bank_decision_ref

shapes.doc: A capability-bound exact statement-close attestation, fixed to the original evaluated prefix and cumulative cash contribution digest. matches names the exact native confirmations relied on. No external principal signature or complete outstanding-item inventory is implied.
shapes.name: bank_reconciliation

shapes.doc: An independently verified historical close and its comparison with the selected status prefix. Monetary equality alone does not hide changed cash contributions or released/replaced matches. changed_entries cites subsequent effective cash contributions; citing_entries retains explicit late-posting and activation-control citations.
shapes.name: bank_reconciliation_state

shapes.doc: An immutable release referring to one exact confirmation, retaining its original releasing principal, current authority commitment and native publication sequence.
shapes.name: bank_unmatch

shapes.doc: A cash leg in the named candidate window that is neither claimed by an active native confirmation nor consumed by a fresh proposal. This is a candidate-window observation, not a full outstanding-item inventory.
shapes.name: bank_outstanding_leg

shapes.doc: Exact gross cash movements in the statement's unit. Inflow and outflow remain separate, so offsetting unresolved items cannot cancel. Bank credits and book debits are inflows.
shapes.name: bank_cash_amounts

shapes.doc: Active progress at the selected prefix. confirmed applies to this manifest; occupied means the original source line is claimed under another interpretation. remaining includes occupied, proposed and unmatched lines. outstanding covers only available cash legs inside the declared candidate window. all_statement_lines_confirmed and closing_balances_equal are independent observations; they do not attest a balance or establish a posting lock.
shapes.name: bank_reconciliation_progress

shapes.doc: Third-party-authored text from an imported document, entry description, or leg memo (plan §9.3 prompt-injection boundary): `untrusted_content` carries the UTF-8 text and `source` names its handle (`D:<oid>`, `E:<vid>`, or `E:<vid>:L<ordinal>`). Untrusted text is never interpolated into `fix`, `next_actions`, or `suggested_tool_calls`.
shapes.name: untrusted_text

shapes.doc: One leg of a committed entry.
shapes.name: entry_leg

shapes.doc: One proposed leg after actual admission, with the resolved account code and immutable account identity. Its amount is an exact decimal string with the book's unit.
shapes.name: plan_leg

shapes.doc: One ordered member of the joint correction artifact: exact request and prepared-entry digests, accounting preview, provenance and approval count. The complete sealed entry and approvals are retained in the artifact bytes.
shapes.name: replacement_plan_member

shapes.doc: One ordered member of an atomic batch rehearsal, with its derived entry identity and exact request/prepared digests. Complete sealed bytes and supplied approvals remain in the portable artifact.
shapes.name: batch_plan_member

shapes.doc: One admitted batch leg including exact native/base amounts, application references and registered dimensions. Earlier batch members may be settlement targets; the native carried transaction independently validates their immutable digests and available amounts.
shapes.name: batch_plan_leg

shapes.doc: One exact application to an existing or earlier batch member's entry and leg.
shapes.name: batch_plan_settlement

shapes.doc: One registered dimension identifier and its immutable value identity.
shapes.name: batch_plan_dimension

shapes.doc: The account's cell in one unit: the posted column and the pending column.
shapes.name: explained_cell

shapes.doc: One leg that bears on the cells: `column` is posted, pending (an outstanding reservation), or released (a reservation a Resolution released at `released_at`; in neither column).
shapes.name: contribution

shapes.doc: What an entry supersedes, how, and the preparer's stated reason. reason is null for a historical code outside the current registry; the recorded numeric code is always preserved.
shapes.name: lineage

shapes.doc: A document the entry cites, with its public commitment.
shapes.name: evidence_head

shapes.doc: The cell in one unit as known after `recorded_at`, at every sequence that touched it.
shapes.name: cell_change

shapes.doc: One leg of an explained entry, with its resolved account code and name.
shapes.name: explained_entry_leg

shapes.doc: One cited document in an entry's evidence closure, with its metadata, reviews, supplements, and whether it counts toward the class minimum.
shapes.name: explained_document

shapes.doc: A Reviewed attestation over a cited document.
shapes.name: explained_review

shapes.doc: A SupplementalEvidence link recorded against an entry.
shapes.name: explained_supplement

shapes.doc: One SupplementalEvidence recorded against an entry (`fa document attach`), with every document it cites.
shapes.name: evidence_supplement

shapes.doc: A ManualAssertion attestation bound to an entry's proposal digest.
shapes.name: explained_manual_assertion

shapes.doc: One cell of the Appendix C admissibility matrix (`admissibility.toml`).
shapes.name: explained_admissibility_cell

shapes.doc: One segregation-of-duties rule from `sod_policy.toml`.
shapes.name: explained_sod_rule

shapes.doc: One journaled period-state transition control entry.
shapes.name: period_transition_row

shapes.doc: What a line describes (plan §4.8), beside the envelope's `book` (the book id): the branch (`trunk`; drafts and scenarios land later), `known_at` (the recorded sequence: the head when read, or the one --as-known-at selected; after a write, the head that write produced), and `effective` (`all`, `period:<code>`, `periods:<code>,<code>…`, or `as-of:<YYYY-MM-DD>`). `time_evidence` is null for sequence/HEAD reads; instant reads and their replays retain the original observed frontier, resolved sequence and tick brackets.
shapes.name: coordinate

shapes.doc: The retained resolution of a requested UTC instant under plan §7.1a. precision is tick_bucket; source_grade preserves clock corroboration. A null upper bracket is open at frontier. This does not establish a physical commit instant, and replay uses this saved frontier.
shapes.name: time_evidence

shapes.doc: One journaled TimeEvidence observation and its immutable entry identity. source 0 is the daemon clock; monotonic_ok records corroboration, not proof of UTC accuracy.
shapes.name: time_tick

shapes.doc: A command an agent usually runs next, and why. It omits --book: run it with the same --book.
shapes.name: next_action

shapes.doc: The invariant clauses this build enforces (registries/invariants.toml, fa-37f): `live` lists the clause ids whose checker runs (FA-INV-nn.clause), `gate_g1` the clauses Gate G1 requires; a dormant G1 clause is a G1 blocker.
shapes.name: invariant_clauses

shapes.doc: An operation that cannot be undone in practice: refused with FA-REF-007 (exit 7) unless --yes (or a --plan file) confirms it. `subcommand` is null for a verb without subcommands; `condition` says when it applies; `safe` is the alternative the refusal names.
shapes.name: dangerous_op

shapes.doc: A planted accounting or forensic ground-truth fact in an initialized demo book (`fa demo init`).
shapes.name: planted_fact

shapes.doc: One cost-basis lot on an `AnyUnit` account: its acquiring entry and leg ordinals (`qty_ordinal` in the non-base quantity unit, `cost_ordinal` in the book's base unit), original/relieved/open quantities and costs, and ordered `RELIEVES` applications.
shapes.name: lot_item

shapes.doc: One disposal application (`RELIEVES {quantity, cost}`) against a lot; `live` is false when a reversal (`UNSETTLES`) undid the relief.
shapes.name: lot_relief

shapes.doc: A deterministic lot disposal relief plan under `FIFO`, `LIFO`, `SpecificId`, or `WeightedAverage` (`lot_laws.toml`, plan §6.5), with exact per-lot slices and `wac_residual_numerator`.
shapes.name: lot_disposal_plan

shapes.doc: One lot slice relieved by a planned disposal, with before/after open quantities and costs.
shapes.name: lot_disposal_slice

shapes.doc: One entry in a `SUPERSEDES` lineage component, with its liveness and supersession links and registered netting laws. reverses_reversal flags an entry that reverses a Reversal, reviving what that reversal negated (plan §8.2).
shapes.name: lineage_step

shapes.doc: One `SUPERSEDES` edge with its registered `netting_law` (`supersession_kinds.toml`).
shapes.name: lineage_edge

shapes.doc: Net economic effect `(debit - credit)` of a `SUPERSEDES` lineage component on one `(account, unit)` cell.
shapes.name: lineage_net_cell

shapes.doc: One nominal posting account's explicitly journaled Equity destination.
shapes.name: closing_route

shapes.doc: An exact debit-minus-credit nominal balance before close, preserving the native unit and optional legal entity. closes_to is the destination Equity account VID; a positive net requires a credit to the nominal account.
shapes.name: closing_residual

shapes.doc: The immediate predecessor verified from its retained original statement, canonical manifest and native ImportRun receipt. This records structural statement continuity, not a reconciliation confirmation.
shapes.name: bank_import_predecessor

shapes.doc: A matter's production profile as its ProductionControl records state it (plan §13.2, Appendix A ProductionProfile).
shapes.name: production_summary

shapes.doc: One document's Bates range in a matter and the Produce record that assigned it. doc_commit is the document's unchanged public commitment.
shapes.name: bates_range

shapes.doc: One matter's Bates range for a document.
shapes.name: matter_bates_range

shapes.doc: One document of a production volume: its range, whether this production numbered it, whether it ships only as a redacted listing, and its native path in the volume (null when redacted).
shapes.name: produced_range

shapes.doc: One privilege-log row (plan §13.2): a produced document delivered only redacted (bates is its range) or a document withheld in full (bates is null), with the producer's claim; date is null when no claim states it. treatment is WITHHELD_IN_FULL or REDACTED_IN_PART(contract=…, withheld_chunks=…/…).
shapes.name: privilege_row

shapes.doc: A bundle-scoped production's evidence bundle: its digest, the recorded checkpoint it was produced against, the book's checkpoint signing key (fa-verify's --key) and the exact offline verification command for the volume's .fab and .receipt.
shapes.name: production_bundle

shapes.doc: One journaled accumulator state: its oid, the commit that recorded it, the entry prefix it covers (through_seq), its leaf count, its evidence boundary (null: entries alone), root and predecessor.
shapes.name: checkpoint_state

shapes.doc: A period the calendar generates: code, ordinal in its fiscal year, kind, civil bounds and whether the book has recorded it.
shapes.name: calendar_period

shapes.doc: One target of fa verify book: its name, its verdict (pass, fail, error or skipped) and the failure or skip reason (empty on pass).
shapes.name: verify_target

shapes.doc: A registered law: its family (rounding, allocation, conversion, fx, lot, tracing), id, name, optional version, and every other registry field as key/value text, in key order.
shapes.name: law_row

shapes.doc: One field of a law's registry row, rendered as text (arrays joined with commas).
shapes.name: law_attribute

shapes.doc: A unit version: id, code, version, immutable scale, kind, ISO 4217 number (null when none) and the name of its default rounding law.
shapes.name: unit_row

shapes.doc: A restatement case (plan §8.3): its number and vertex, kind, state, the periods it affects, its optional narrative document, its determination (day and authority document), its rehearsal, its approved manifest, the entries it posted, its disclosure and every journaled transition in commit order.
shapes.name: restatement_case

shapes.doc: One entry a case will post: the scenario's Plan record, the digest of its intent and the principal who planned it.
shapes.name: case_manifest_entry

shapes.doc: A case's disclosure: the Disclosure document and the Reviewed attestation over it.
shapes.name: case_disclosure

shapes.doc: One entry a case posted: the scenario's Plan record it derives from, the entry and its digest.
shapes.name: case_posted_entry

shapes.doc: A case's approved effect manifest: its digest, its entries and the Approval vertices the Approve record cites.
shapes.name: case_approval

shapes.doc: A case's rehearsal: the scenario the correction ran on, the digest of its diff certificate (retained in the book), the trunk sequence the scenario forked at, the periods the diff covers and the scenario's Plan records it covers, in planning order (the entries the case will post).
shapes.name: case_rehearsal

shapes.doc: When a case's determination was made and the document recording its authority.
shapes.name: case_determination

shapes.doc: One journaled CaseControl transition: from (null for the Open record), to, its record, sequence and principal.
shapes.name: case_transition

shapes.doc: One statement issuance: its vertex, period and ordinal, the statement definition, the retained certificate it issued with that certificate's known-at (certified_at), the audience and the optional transmittal document. control_entry, recorded_at, principal and approvals are those of its IssuanceControl record, null in a plan.
shapes.name: statement_issuance

shapes.doc: One recorded read: vid and digest of the record, the sequence it was recorded at and the head it observed, the principal (vid and name), capability commitment and ops, the command and the digest of its arguments.
shapes.name: access_event

shapes.doc: One unit of a presented statement: the divisor applied to exact mantissas, the presented statement's digest, and its lines in definition order with residual lines inserted.
shapes.name: presented_unit

shapes.doc: A presented statement line: presented integers per column, the exact rounding error per column, and whether it is an explicit presentation-rounding residual line.
shapes.name: presented_line

shapes.doc: Plan Appendix D refusal object: the instance id, catalog code, exit, what failed, where, why, the structured fix, alternative commands and the docs command.
shapes.name: refusal_object

shapes.doc: A refusal's fix: the prose, the first parseable `fa` command it names (whole line and argv after `fa`), the field change that satisfies the law, and the arguments that, added to the same command, make it admissible (`--yes`, `--grant <op>`; null when none do or in a launch-bound session).
shapes.name: refusal_fix

shapes.doc: The field to change and the values it admits, best match first.
shapes.name: refusal_field_change

shapes.doc: A covered leaf two or more definition lines map, with those lines.
shapes.name: statement_lint_overlap

shapes.doc: A covered leaf and the one definition line that maps it.
shapes.name: statement_lint_mapping

shapes.doc: One FX-valued entry whose recorded valuation does not recompute: its vid, recording sequence, the FX law its base totals name and why.
shapes.name: fx_conversion_drift

shapes.doc: One file written into the production volume directory: its path inside the volume, size and BLAKE3 digest under fa:production-file:v1.
shapes.name: production_file
